Class BankAccountServiceTest

@IsTest()
private class BankAccountServiceTest

Tests for BankAccountService. Exercises makeDefault() against the Mercury (org-wide) and venue-scoped (ACH, Link) scoping rules to confirm the chosen bank account is promoted and any peer defaults are demoted, plus the no-op path when the target is already default and the DML-failure path through updateBankAccounts.

private static void
makeDefaultAlreadyDefaultTest()
Calling makeDefault on a bank account that is already flagged as default and has no peers to demote performs no DML and still returns true.
private static void
makeDefaultExceptionTest()
Drives the updateBankAccounts failure path directly: forces a per-record DML failure (over-long ExternalId__c) and verifies the method returns false.
private static void
makeDefaultSetsAchAsDefaultTest()
Promoting a single ACH bank account for a venue must flip its IsDefault__c to true when no other ACH account exists for that venue.
private static void
makeDefaultSwitchesDefaultTest()
Promoting a Link row that points at another venue's bank account must mark the Link as the default for its own venue and demote the venue's previously-default peer.
private static void
makeDefaultSwitchesMercuryDefaultTest()
Promoting a non-default Mercury bank account must flip its IsDefault__c to true and demote the previously-default Mercury peer to false.

private static void makeDefaultSwitchesDefaultTest()

Promoting a Link row that points at another venue's bank account must mark the Link as the default for its own venue and demote the venue's previously-default peer. Bank accounts on the parent's venue are not touched. Returns true.
